answer: Vehicle registration binding: an operator links the agent to one registered vehicle. Validators query the motor-vehicle registry with the plate and VIN, confirm the owner name and current road tax, then keep a salted VIN hash so each car backs one identity. Fifty agents run from one garage on karst hills still share one VIN; every extra identity needs another taxed, insured vehicle, a real yearly cost. Limit: fleet firms can register many vans, crystal-clear ownership data leaks location, and people at the nadir of income who own no car are excluded.
